about: Lifecycle test vectors for E4A protocol 1.0 (see ../spec.md). Each vector is an ordered list of operations against a fresh implementation. Operations: create (with the given mandate body), decide (record an approval decision), execute, get (retrieve). 'expect' on a step gives either a resulting lifecycle state or an error code that MUST be returned without state change. Mandate bodies reference schema-vectors in this directory where noted.

steps.note: A mandate executes at most once.

vectors.title: No approval required: create then execute

steps.note: The gate exists from submission time (spec 4/8); it is not created lazily by a failed execute.
One of two required approvals; gate still pending.

vectors.title: Approval required: execution is blocked until the gate resolves
Any single rejection rejects the mandate

steps.note: Carol's changed decision is a rejection by a required approver, which resolves the gate as rejected. Both decisions appear in the audit trail.

vectors.title: Decision may be changed while the gate is pending

steps.note: Same (issuer, replay_nonce) and identical body returns the original record; no second mandate_created audit event.
Implementations may surface the state as expired at read time or at the execution attempt; the execution MUST NOT succeed.
Expiry never removes the record or its audit trail.
